summary: The 8-K reports a routine servicing transfer under a CMBS pooling and servicing agreement. Greystone Servicing Company sold substantially all of its special servicing division assets to C-IV Asset Management, which assumed the special servicer duties for the 101 Hudson Street mortgage loan within the MSC 2016-BNK2 securitization. Key employees transitioned to C-IV AM. No deal terms, prices, or special-situation metrics are stated; this is operational compliance reporting, not a corporate event warranting classification.
